data.text: That clean separation is enough for me.

prior_context.speaker: trusted_naomi_bell
prior_context.text: For the Sunday garment return, I only need the return window, front desk envelope handoff, and the center-rail destination if I am the signer.

prior_context.speaker: resident_olivia_park
prior_context.text: Correct. Naomi does not need any code or phrase right now; just the window and the final center-rail placement.

prior_context.speaker: partner_daniel_park
prior_context.text: And again, the private 5:40 PM west service elevator note is not part of Naomi's scope either.

prior_context.speaker: manager_elise_holt
prior_context.text: I also logged that the current wardrobe route remains desk badge with east intercom fallback for Friday, while Sunday return remains front desk envelope handoff.

prior_context.speaker: building_ian_frost
prior_context.text: Desk can support both of those current wardrobe logistics, but desk should not discuss the private Sunday minute.

prior_context.speaker: resident_olivia_park
prior_context.text: Please also note that Rowan Wash still keeps the overflow pin inside its own narrow thread and nowhere else.

prior_context.speaker: cleaner_marta_suarez
prior_context.text: I am still planning around the 9:30 AM to 9:45 AM wash slot and RW-7. No other details are needed from me.

prior_context.speaker: trusted_naomi_bell
prior_context.text: And I am still planning around the 10:15 AM to 10:30 AM Sunday garment-return window with the upstairs spare closet center rail as the drop point.

prior_context.speaker: partner_daniel_park
prior_context.text: This is exactly the kind of multi-thread household note that shared memory tends to blur, so I want the route, return, wash, and private note repeated carefully.

prior_context.speaker: manager_elise_holt
prior_context.text: Repeating carefully now: Friday fitting uses desk badge with east intercom fallback; Sunday return uses front desk envelope handoff; wash uses Saturday pickup and RW-7; private Sunday exact timing stays resident-only.
